alt: Two columns of coloured boxes. LeNet: 28 by 28 image, convolution, average pooling, convolution, average pooling, dense 120, 84, 10, with sigmoid. AlexNet: 224 by 224 colour image, five convolution layers with three max-pooling layers, then dense 4096, 4096 and 1000 with ReLU and dropout.

alt: Two block diagrams side by side. Left, a normal block: a weight layer, an activation and another weight layer give f(x). Right, a residual block: the same layers give g(x) and the input x is added back by a skip connection to give f(x) = g(x) + x.
author: Zhang, Lipton, Li & Smola (Dive into Deep Learning)

alt: Two ResNet blocks. Left, input x goes through 3 by 3 convolution, batch norm, ReLU, 3 by 3 convolution, batch norm, and is added to x before a final ReLU. Right, the same block but the shortcut passes through a 1 by 1 convolution first.
author: Zhang, Lipton, Li & Smola (Dive into Deep Learning)

alt: An RNN with a hidden box h that has a loop on itself, with arrow Unfold to a chain of copies h(t-1), h(t), h(t+1), each with its own input x and output o and an arrow passing memory to the next copy.
author: fdeloche

alt: Left, one RNN cell: the old state h and the new input x are each multiplied by weights, added, and passed through tanh to give the output and the state for the next cell. Right, two identical cells in sequence with inputs x0 and x1.
author: Daniel Voigt Godoy

alt: A stacked RNN: inputs X1 to XT at the bottom, several layers of hidden states H going left to right, and outputs O1 to OT at the top, where each layer feeds the layer above.

alt: A bidirectional RNN: inputs X1 to XT feed a forward hidden chain moving left to right and a backward hidden chain moving right to left, and both feed each output O.
author: Zhang, Lipton, Li & Smola (Dive into Deep Learning)

alt: An RNN unrolled over three steps with inputs x1 to x3, hidden states h1 to h3, outputs o1 to o3 and targets y1 to y3 all feeding one loss L, with the shared weights shown below.
author: Zhang, Lipton, Li & Smola (Dive into Deep Learning)

alt: An LSTM cell: the cell state c(t-1) runs along the top through a multiply and an add to c(t). Three sigmoid layers and one tanh layer take h(t-1) and x(t); the output gate multiplies tanh of the cell state to give h(t).

alt: An LSTM unit drawn between time steps: inputs x, outputs o, and the unit passing c and h to the next step, with the forget, input and output gates marked F, I and O.

alt: A GRU cell: h[t-1] and x[t] go through a reset gate r and an update gate z (sigmoid) and a tanh candidate; z and 1-z mix the old state and the candidate to give h[t].
